_comment: Single source of truth for the chat assistant. The AI (api/chat.js) and the offline FAQ fallback (assets/chat.js) both read this file. Keep it factual: the bot will only say what is written here.

business.name: Siswaa Technologies
business.what: A founder-run software studio in India. Websites on a monthly plan, Android and iOS apps, full-stack web apps, and care and revamp of existing apps and websites.
business.founders: Atul Singh Bhadouria and Abhishek Sharma, both developers. Clients talk directly to the people building their product.
business.area: Anywhere in India. Work happens over WhatsApp, phone and video calls.

plans.name: Starter
plans.includes: 1-page website, domain, hosting and SSL, WhatsApp and call buttons, Google Maps link, 1 update every month
plans.bestFor: Shops and local businesses that just need customers to find and call them

plans.name: Business
plans.includes: Up to 5 pages, enquiry form, photo gallery, Google Business profile setup, basic SEO, 3 updates every month
plans.bestFor: Most businesses: clinics, salons, coaching centres, restaurants that want enquiries. The most popular plan.

plans.name: Growth
plans.includes: Everything in Business, plus online booking or ordering, online payments, priority support, monthly visitor report
plans.bestFor: Businesses that want to take bookings, orders or payments online

planRules: Yearly plans give 2 months free and the setup fee is waived.
Monthly plans are paid by UPI AutoPay or card and have a 6-month minimum.
After the minimum, monthly plans can be cancelled with 30 days' notice.
Founding client offer: the first 10 clients get the setup fee waived.

services.name: App and full-stack builds
services.details: Android and iOS apps, web apps and dashboards, customer portals, first versions (MVPs) for founders, backends and APIs. One fixed price after a free call. No per-hour billing.

services.name: Care and revamp
services.details: Fix bugs, update apps for new Android and iOS versions, redesign, move to new hosting and put it live again, ongoing care. Care plans from ₹4,999/month. Start with a free app health check.

process: 1. Message on WhatsApp and describe the business and what is needed.
2. Siswaa plans it and gives a fixed price before starting.
3. Siswaa builds it. Websites go live in about 7 days once details and photos are received. Progress is shared on WhatsApp.
4. Launch, and Siswaa keeps it running. Changes are requested by message.
portfolio: Easipaper (easipaper.in), built and run by Siswaa: 39 free paperwork tools for Indian salary, tax, rent and HR. Runs entirely in the browser, no sign-up, no server storing data, updated for FY 2026-27 rules. Siswaa is new; the first client sites will be added as they launch.

faq.a: You do. The domain is in your business's name, and your content and photos are yours. If you ever want to move, Siswaa hands everything over.
Yes. Monthly plans have a 6-month minimum, and after that you can cancel any time with 30 days' notice. Yearly plans run for the year you've paid for.
Monthly plans are paid by UPI AutoPay or card, so you never have to remember. Yearly plans are paid once for the whole year, and the setup fee is waived.
Websites go live in about 7 days once Siswaa has your details and photos. For apps and bigger builds you get a timeline together with the fixed price.
Yes. Siswaa works over WhatsApp, phone and video calls, so it works the same anywhere in India.

faq.q: What if I already have a website or app?
faq.a: Siswaa can fix it, update it, redesign it or move it. Start with a free app health check and you'll be told, in plain words, what needs work. Care plans start at ₹4,999/month.

Starter (₹399/month) is a 1-page site so customers can find and call you. Business (₹999/month) is the most popular: up to 5 pages, enquiry form, gallery and Google Business setup. Growth (₹2,499/month) adds online booking, ordering and payments. Tell me what your business does and I'll suggest one.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: Websites start at ₹399/month (Starter) plus a ₹999 one-time setup. Business is ₹999/month and Growth is ₹2,499/month. Pay yearly and you get 2 months free with no setup fee.

faq.q: How much does an app cost?
faq.a: Apps and custom builds get one fixed price after a free call, because every app is different. There's no hourly billing, and you know the full cost before work starts.

Siswaa built and runs Easipaper (easipaper.in): 39 free paperwork tools for Indian salary, tax, rent and HR that run entirely in the browser. Siswaa is new, so the first 10 clients get the setup fee waived.
